acls.description: List of principals allowed to receive Kerberos database replication (kpropd ACL entries). Each entry defines a principal and optional pattern matching mode.

principal.description: Kerberos principal or principal pattern (e.g., kadmin/admin@EXAMPLE.COM or */admin@EXAMPLE.COM)

pattern.description: Pattern type for matching: 'exact' (default), 'wildcard' ('*' matches any realm/service), or 'suffix' (e.g., matches realm suffix). If omitted, defaults to exact match.
